title: Negation-Aware Weighted Information Fusion for Reliable Evidential Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2509.00754v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Dempster--Shafer theory (DST) provides an attractive framework for multi-source information fusion. However, its effectiveness critically depends on how a BPA is constructed for each source. Existing methods often rely on heuristic mappings or restrict belief assignment to singleton hypotheses and the full set, thereby underutilizing the expressive belief structure of BPAs for representing ambiguity.This paper proposes Negation-Aware Weighted Information Fusion (NAWIF).First, NAWIF transforms the class-wise possibility distribution of each source into a set of negation-aware simple BPAs, which encode class exclusion through complementary propositions and retain residual uncertainty in the full set. Their combination produces a closed-form BPA over composite hypotheses, preserving ambiguity among the classes not excluded by the source. translated_title: 面向可靠证据推理的否定感知加权信息融合
translated_abstract: Dempster-Shafer理论（DST）为多源信息融合提供了一个极具吸引力的框架。然而，其有效性关键取决于如何为每个信息源构建基本概率分配（BPA）。现有方法通常依赖启发式映射，或将信念分配限制在单例假设和全集上，从而未能充分利用BPA的表达性信念结构来刻画模糊性。本文提出了否定感知加权信息融合方法（NAWIF）。首先，NAWIF将每个信息源的类级可能性分布转换为一组否定感知的简单BPA，这些BPA通过互补命题编码类排除信息，并在全集中保留残余不确定性。它们的组合在复合假设上产生闭式解的BPA，保留了未被该信息源排除的类之间的模糊性。该方法进一步基于各信息源的可靠性和不确定性执行特定于源的BPA折扣，抑制……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 提出否定感知加权信息融合方法NAWIF，通过将类级可能性分布转换为否定感知的简单BPA并基于可靠性与不确定性进行折扣加权，从而更充分地表示模糊性并实现可靠的多源证据推理。
en_tdlr: Proposes NAWIF, a negation-aware weighted information fusion method that transforms class-wise possibility distributions into negation-aware simple BPAs and applies reliability- and uncertainty-based discounting, enabling more reliable multi-source evidential reasoning while fully exploiting the expressive belief structure of BPAs.
